what: blaze-cas commit retry redoes every pack after any failed step (lib.rs complete/start_commit), so a commit of 7 packs + index (~23 effects) rarely survives a 1-in-9 fault rate: crash-test seeds = 8 mod 12 break the store in 20 of 40 rounds (FAILURES_MOST=8 failed commits in a row). Better design: keep per-pack durable progress (a pack whose WriteAt and Sync both succeeded is durable up to `to`; retry truncates/writes only from there, redoing only the packs whose step failed, which still respects fsyncgate). Not done by tests-store because tests-fuzz has uncommitted edits in crates/blaze-cas/src/lib.rs. Assign to whoever owns blaze-cas.
